not_a_member.title: You are signed in, but not a member here
not_a_member.body: You are signed in as {subject} but you are not a member of any workspace here. Ask an owner for an invitation.

error.title: Sign-in required
error.missing_subject: Your deployment requires sign-in, and this request arrived without an authenticated identity.
error.retry_hint: Sign in at your installation's proxy, then try again here.

invite.subject_mismatch: This invitation was addressed to a different person than the one you are signed in as.

error.invite_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the owner for a fresh invitation.
error.invite_subject_mismatch: This invitation was issued for a different address. You are signed in as {subject}: ask for an invitation for exactly this address.

data.title: Data & Backup
data.intro: Your books are yours. Export the whole workspace to an open format, back it up, or restore a backup onto this machine.

history.empty: No backups yet. Back up now to create a safety net.

restore.title: Restore
restore.hint: Verify a backup file, then restore it into a brand-new workspace. Restore never overwrites an existing workspace.
restore.confirm: Restore this backup into a brand-new workspace? Your current workspaces are left untouched.

catalog.result: {count} tools, each with its REST route.

error.backup_corrupt: This file is damaged and cannot be restored. Choose another file.
error.incompatible_schema_version: This backup is from an incompatible TILL version and cannot be restored.
error.restore_invariant_failed: The backup did not pass the balance check and was not restored.
error.export_destination_unwritable: The export could not be written. Free up space and try again.
error.unrestorable_format: An export (.tillexport) is not a restore source. Use a .tillbackup file.

app.title: TILL Studio
app.tagline: Swiss accounting your agent can actually use.

switcher.loadFailed: The list of workspaces could not be loaded.

help.leavesDevice: opens a page on the internet, which needs a connection

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.hint: Create the first entry to get started.

permission.title: No access
permission.body: You are missing the right needed for this view.

noWorkspace.title: No workspace yet
noWorkspace.body: Set up a workspace first and this view opens up.

kind.label: What kind of feedback is this?
kind.question: A question

subject.label: Subject
subject.required: Please give this a short subject.

message.label: What happened, and what did you expect?

diagnostics.include: Include the error details shown below
diagnostics.denied: You do not have permission to read recorded errors, so none can be included. You can still write the report.

recipient.notice: The report goes to hello@tillbooks.ch. We delete it within 12 months, and you can ask us to delete it sooner.

copy.clipboard_note: Copying puts the report on your clipboard, which some systems sync to your other devices.

saved.title: Report saved
saved.body: TILL saved the report and handed it to your email app. Check that it opened, then send it.
saved.truncated: Your text is longer than an email link can hold, so only part of it is prefilled. Copy the report to get all of it.
saved.no_mail_app: If nothing opened, this computer has no email app set up. Copy the report and send it to hello@tillbooks.ch yourself.

crash_path.not_saved: TILL could not reach its own background service, so this report was not saved. Copy it before you close this.

crash.title: This screen stopped working
crash.body: Reloading is safe. TILL saves only when you confirm an action.

errors.invalid_input: An input was invalid. Please check the fields and try again.
errors.workspace_not_found: The selected workspace could not be found.
errors.workspace_archived: This ledger is archived and read-only. Nothing was changed. It can be reactivated from the workspace roster.
errors.unknown_action: The application does not know this action.
errors.permission_denied: You are missing the right needed for this action. Nothing was changed.
errors.forbidden: Your role is not allowed to perform this action. Nothing was changed.
errors.unexpected_error: Something went wrong inside TILL itself. Nothing was changed. Try again, and report it if it keeps happening.
errors.store_busy: The ledger was busy and could not take this. Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
errors.transport_error: TILL could not reach the ledger service. Nothing was changed. Check that it is running and try again.
errors.fallback: The action could not be completed. Please try again or check your input.
errors.open_documents: This contact still has open documents. Settle or cancel them first.
errors.self_merge: A contact cannot be merged into itself.
errors.invalid_scope: Scope must reference this contact's own records.
errors.grant_denied: This link is no longer valid.
errors.expiry_in_past: The expiry date must be in the future.
errors.grant_revoked: This portal access has already been revoked.
errors.target_merged: That target contact has itself been merged away. Pick the surviving contact.
errors.already_merged: This contact has already been merged.
errors.too_many_tags: Too many tags on this contact. At most 50 are allowed.
errors.tag_too_long: That tag is too long. At most 40 characters are allowed.
errors.occurred_in_future: An activity cannot be dated in the future.
errors.invalid_activity_kind: That activity type is not recognised.
errors.invalid_import_format: The file could not be read. Check the header row and the first bad row.

deeplink.notFound: That link points to a workspace that does not exist or is not yours.

notFound.body: There is no screen at this address. The link may be out of date or mistyped.

palette.legend: Enter to act, Esc to close
palette.empty: Nothing here you can open or run.
palette.askNoRuntime: No local agent runtime is configured.
palette.askFailed: The agent could not answer just now.

dial.label: Publish ledger stream
dial.denied: Only an owner with the manage sync right can change this.

off.body: Publishing is off. TILL publishes no ledger stream; nothing about your books leaves this app.

on.body: Publishing is on. The ledger stream is available to authorised readers. TILL does not connect anywhere by itself.

epoch.label: Epoch
epoch.reset_hint: After a restore the epoch changes. A consumer with an old cursor is told to reset instead of silently reading a forked history.

consumer.title: Consumers
consumer.none: No consumer readout available on this install. Lag is computed from the cursor a consumer presents when it reads.

exit.title: Your exit, any day
exit.body: Your books are yours: backup and export are ready at any time, including when you leave the hosted offering.

tier.note: The managed tier is a separate hosted offering. This install runs locally: turning publishing on makes the stream readable here and connects to nothing by itself.

denied.body: You do not have permission to see the sync posture.

trust.publishing: Publishing on: the ledger stream is available to authorised readers.

verb.payment_batch_transmit: Transmit payment batch to the bank
